forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: Cycles make modules impossible to understand or test in isolation.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: A module nothing imports and that imports nothing is dead code.

forbidden.name: domains-not-to-cli
forbidden.comment: Command-line entry points sit on top; domain modules never depend on them.

forbidden.name: domains-only-to-shared-layers
forbidden.comment: A domain may use its own modules, color and shared, but not another domain.

forbidden.name: production-not-to-tests
forbidden.comment: Production code never imports test code.

forbidden.name: browser-not-to-tools
forbidden.comment: Browser code is shipped to visitors and must not pull in build tooling.

forbidden.name: stable-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Depend in the direction of stability: a module should not import one that is more unstable than itself.
